newsitem.title: USA: World Color completes acquisition of printer.
newsitem.headline: World Color completes acquisition of printer.

text.p: World Color Press Inc said Friday it completed its acquisition of Johnson & Hardin, a publication and commercial printer headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, with annual revenues of about $80 million.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
World Color acquired Johnson & Hardin's two facilities, located in Cincinnati and Lebanon, Ohio, adding 450,000 square feet of production capacity, and 780 employees.
In its July 2 anncouncement of the deal, World Color said it expects the acquisition to boost earnings starting in 1998.
